Sikkim tunnel collapse: Over 20 workers dead, rescue operations conclude

A tunnel collapse at a hydropower project in Sikkim's Namchi district has resulted in the deaths of at least 25 workers. The incident occurred following an explosion, with rescue operations concluding after four days. Teams including NDRF, SDRF, and the Army were involved in the recovery efforts. The bodies of the deceased workers are being brought back to their home districts, with some funerals taking place.
